{{Quote|I need transportation. Get it for me.''"<br />"''You need transportation. I will get it for you.|Obi-Wan Kenobi mind tricks the wrangler|<ref name="Comic" />}}
A [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] '''wrangler''' worked at a [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] corral in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], while Utapau was occupied by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] visited the corral, seeking a way to climb the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] wall to reach the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. He [[Force power/Legends|used]] a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to manipulate the [[Beastmaster/Legends|wrangler]] into providing a varactyl, and used his [[Force sense/Legends|Force sense]] to select [[Boga/Legends|Boga]] as his mount. The wrangler gave Kenobi a [[Saddle/Legends|saddle]] and the Jedi rode Boga into [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|battle]] against Grievous.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I cannot pay you. As compensation, I can only offer the freedom of your planet. I hope that will suffice.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to the varactyl wranglers|<ref name="ROTS novel" />}}
A member of the [[Utai/Legends|Utai]] [[Species/Legends|species]] worked as a [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] wrangler in [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]],<ref name="Comic" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]]<ref name="ROTS novel" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="Comic" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Utapau was occupied by the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="ROTS novel" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' places the events of {{Film|III}}, including the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> the Republic-affiliated [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived on Utapau and sought to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Grievous&mdash;the new Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]]&mdash;to end the war. Kenobi knew that he would need to scale the walls of the [[City/Legends|city's]] [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] wall to reach [[Level 10/Legends|Level 10]], where Grievous was entrenched.<ref name="Fact File">{{FactFile2014|39|19 BBY 25-30|The Battle of Utapau}}</ref>

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] arrived at the varactyl corral and [[Force power/Legends|used]] a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to instruct the Utai [[Beastmaster/Legends|wrangler]] to provide him with one of the creatures.<ref name="Comic" /> The Utai watched Kenobi's [[Limb/Legends|hand]] as though in a daze,<ref name="Foe">''[[Obi-Wan's Foe]]''</ref> and his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] appeared distant for a moment<ref name="ROTS novel" /> before he repeated Kenobi's command<ref name="Comic" /> and turned to talk to the other Utai present in the [[Utai (language)|Utai language]] and retrieve a [[Saddle/Legends|saddle]]. The Jedi surveyed the varactyls there and used the Force to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] the inner qualities of the creatures that would suit his needs. Kenobi selected the varactyl [[Boga/Legends|Boga]] due to the commitment to obedience and loyalty he sensed within her.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

[[File:GoodGirlBoga.png|thumb|right|350px|The wrangler introduces Obi-Wan Kenobi to Boga.]]
He told the wrangler&mdash;who had returned with the saddle&mdash;of his choice, and the wrangler gave the Jedi her name and began tacking up the varactyl with the other wranglers. Kenobi fed Boga from a selection of leaves nearby and called the creature a "good [[Gender/Legends|girl]]," but realized he did not know the creature's gender and pronouns and asked the wrangler for clarification. The wrangler responded in Utai and shrugged, which Kenobi took to mean that he did not understand the question. The Jedi mounted Boga and apologized to the wranglers that he had no [[Currency/Legends|currency]] to pay them, instead hoping that winning freedom for their planet would suffice. Kenobi rode Boga up to Level 10 and throughout his combat with Grievous in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], in which he defeated the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] general.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Boga. She answers to Boga.|The wrangler, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Comic" />}}
The Utai was susceptible to mind tricks, stood at a short height,<ref name="ROTS novel" /> and had pale [[Color/Legends|pink]] skin.<ref name="Comic" /> The wrangler mainly [[Language/Legends|spoke]] in Utai, but could comprehend some of Kenobi's gestures. The Utai gave some confused looks to Kenobi when he did not understand the Jedi's speech.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

==Skills and abilities==
The wrangler could speak some phrases in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="Comic" />

==Equipment==
The Utai wore a blue [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]],<ref name="Comic" /> and handled equipment for riding varactyls, such as saddles.<ref name="ROTS novel" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Warool noggaggllo?|The wrangler's Utai dialogue from the film novelization, which Obi-Wan Kenobi interprets to mean "I have no idea what you're saying to me"|<ref name="ROTS novel" />}}
The Utai wrangler was created by ''[[Star Wars]]'' creator [[George Lucas]] for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Illustrated">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref> Storyboards featuring the Utai were designed by [[Derek Thompson]].<ref name="Storyboards">''[[Star Wars Storyboards: The Prequel Trilogy]]''</ref> The wrangler's first appearance came in the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 2|second issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith (comic series)|comic adaptation]], written by [[Christopher Cerasi]] under the pseudonym Miles Lane,<ref name="Epic Collection">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Clone Wars Vol. 4]]''</ref> illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Comic" /> on [[March 23]], [[2005]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54229/star_wars_episode_iii_-_revenge_of_the_sith_2005_2|text=Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005) #2}}</ref> The character was ultimately cut from the finished film,<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> which premiered on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> In the film's [[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|novelization]], written by [[Matthew Stover]]<ref name="ROTS" /> and published on [[April 2]], 2005,<ref name="RandomHouse">{{RandomHouseOld|url=author/results.pperl?authorid=30059|text=Matthew Woodring Stover}}</ref> the wrangler's dialogue is only in Utai,<ref name="ROTS novel" /> whereas he responds in Basic in other sources, including the comic<ref name="Comic" /> and the children's book ''[[Obi-Wan's Foe]]'',<ref name="Foe" /> also published on April 2.<ref name="Amazon">{{RandomHouseOld|url=catalog/display.pperl?isbn=037580000X|text=Obi-Wan's Foe}}</ref> This article follows the latter two sources.
